verdicts.id: packages/better-auth/src/plugins/organization/organization.test.ts::cancel pending invitations on re-invite > should cancel pending invitation and create a new one when re-inviting without resend
verdicts.reason: It checks only outcomes the instruction specifies (no error, pending status, a new id, one pending and one canceled invitation in listInvitations), and it does so through the public client API, so it does not inspect the implementation.
